name: all-clear
purpose: A small, entirely healthy deployment: eight sources, one enricher, one view, every producer ran, the latest attempt published, no failing check, empty queue.
edge_cases: Nothing is wrong: Home's Needs attention must be one sentence carrying the fact that makes it so, and no red may appear anywhere on the page (S5).
The queue is empty and the worker is reporting, so the runtime checks list is empty rather than absent.
Every producer state is 'updated', so the Sources count strip has one populated bucket.
